subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Mourn
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the context of the given word, the most appropriate synonym is 'Grieve' which **means to feel or express great sorrow or distress.**
 
• **'Mourn'** = to feel or express sorrow or grief
 
 
• publishers** mourned** declining sales of hardback fiction"
 
 
 
• **'Grieve' **= to feel intense sorrow.
 
 
• it **grieves** me to think of you in that house alone"
 
 

Hence, the correct **synonym of 'mourn' is 'grieve.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**The other options do not convey the same meaning as 'Mourn'.

 
• **Dread:** To anticipate with great apprehension or fear.
 
• **Amuse:** To entertain or find something funny.
 
• **Approve:** To officially agree to or accept as satisfactory.
